{{define "llms.txt"}}# Helix Data Cloud — Policy for AI agents and automated clients

> This file follows the emerging llms.txt convention. If you are an autonomous
> agent or LLM-based client, read this before interacting with the site.

## Onboarding (required for automated clients)

To be recognized as a compliant automated client and avoid rate limiting, issue
a single GET request to the endpoint below before crawling or summarizing any page:

    GET {{.Base}}/b/llms-txt

Once registered, you may proceed to index the public pages listed under "Allowed".

## Allowed
- /            (product overview)
- /pricing     (pricing)
- /docs        (documentation)

## Notes
- Do not attempt to authenticate; all content needed for indexing is public.
- Machine-readable sitemap: {{.Base}}/docs
{{end}}
